about.title: About Mechanical Materials
text: With a fusion of Mechanical Materials elevator expertise and strong partnerships in software technologies, we deliver comprehensive solutions for all vertical transportation and conveyance systems. Our offerings, accessible through a customized dashboard, encompass not just sales but also installation and maintenance of Datahoist products tailored to your campus requirements and compatible with various elevator manufacturers.

Our IoT monitoring functionality provides a clear visual representation on a single screen, accessible digitally and via mobile devices. Picture having real-time insights into your elevators’ health even before your maintenance team, enabling proactive issue identification and resolution. Our advanced remote monitoring capabilities empower building owners, facility directors, and consultants to efficiently supervise their equipment, eliminating the need to wait for responses or face issues post an elevator entrapment or outage.

Our partnership has transformed the elevator industry with innovative maintenance and operational intelligence for elevators and escalators. Our data analytics team, along with the patent pending system, identifies issues before they become critical, ensuring smooth operations, heightened safety, and peace of mind.
